text:
noah: quick proposal for handling midstream faults at the gateway: instead of attempting stateful lease transfers, abort streaming and deliver a single buffered payload (from cache or retry) + an explicit degrade event. simpler and less error-prone.

emma: this keeps the edge stateless which is 👍. main downside is losing incremental UX for streaming consumers. should be route-configurable.

noah: exactly. config example I had in mind:
```json
{"degrade_mode":"buffered_retry","allow_cache":true,"apply_to_tiers":["free","standard"]}
```

ben: two operational questions: 1) how do we avoid duplicate side-effects if the upstream already executed tool calls? 2) cost/billing when we re-run?

sofia: for side-effects require Idempotency-Key for any request that can trigger tools. If absent, fallback becomes an error payload explaining the limitation. Billing: only bill for the final succeeded run; mark telemetry as degraded_run so Finance can filter.

emma: implementation sketch at the proxy layer:
```pseudo
on midstream_error:
  send_event_to_client({"edge_degraded":true})
  close_upstream_stream()
  if cache.hit and route.allow_cache:
    payload = cache.get(key)
  elif req.has_idempotency:
    payload = backend.call_nonstream(req.with_idempotency())
  else:
    payload = error_body("cannot rerun without idempotency")
  send_single_chunk_to_client(payload)
```

ben: add X-Edge-Degraded:true header and X-Edge-Fallback:cache|rerun|error. Also set X-Edge-KV-Bypass:true when we rerun so prefix KV doesn't contaminate results.

sofia: observability checklist: metrics (edge.degraded.count, degraded.cache_hit, degraded.rerun_count), trace span with fallback_reason, fallback_trace_id linking to attempted lease ops. Add logs at INFO when fallback occurs.

noah: SDK/FE note: SDKs should detect the degrade event and show an unobtrusive banner like "Degraded to single-response". we'll add guidance in docs.

emma: tests: unit for decision logic, integration that simulates partial tokens + upstream abort and asserts SSE event + single chunk, and e2e to confirm billing tags. deploy-bot: gate behind feature flag ingress.degrade.buffered_retry?

deploy-bot: action items created: update proxy schema, add feature-flag ingress.degrade.buffered_retry, add metrics + traces, add integration tests, update SDK docs.

ben: rollout plan: behind flag -> canary on internal/non-critical routes for 48h -> open to free/standard if stable -> keep enterprise on resumable flow. Monitor fallback_rate and client-side error spikes.

sofia: minor UX idea: emit a short SSE chunk before closing that contains {"degraded":true, "reason":"circuit_breaker"} so clients can surface precise messaging.

noah: agreed. I'll draft a short RFC addendum including config schema, metric names, example SDK snippet, and a small diagram comparing resumable vs buffered_retry flows. tagging @emma for metrics and @ben for idempotency gating.

emma: +1. I can write the rollout checklist and observability playbook.

noah: thanks all. aiming to land behind flag next week and canary in staging.
